episodes.sampling_policy: Uniform held-out genus draw without replacement; independent Bernoulli(0.5) physical-cluster partition conditioned on sufficient rows for all chosen genera; uniform rows without replacement within each genus/side. No class draws skipped.
episodes.support_query_policy: Globally disjoint canonical rows_thr0.3 groups, including mixed-host groups. Disjoint genome rows; multiple groups may contribute to each genus/side. Same class draws and queries at every shot count; support is a nested prefix of the maximum-shot support array.
episodes.query_count_selection: Fixed before scoring from count-only feasibility; 10 queries retained because all nine held-out genera are eligible.

inference: Frozen representations only; nearest cosine prototype from support genomes. No fine-tuning, no supervised head logits or probabilities, no unseen genus labels in representation training/validation. No hyperparameter selection uses held-out labels or episode scores.
uncertainty: Training-seed SD and episode Monte Carlo SE are reported separately. Episodes reuse finite genomes and physical clusters; episode MC SE/paired episode bootstrap describe conditional episode sampling only and are not evidence of biological significance or new-database generalization.
